title: Alan Fontus knows something

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Can I help you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Be cautious. Anyone who can afford Grey Tech is likely to have other defenses... Though I detect no intrusion tech so far.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be cautious. Anyone who can afford Grey Tech is likely to have other defenses... Though I detect no intrusion tech so far.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Yes. Are we already companions? I do not recall a previous meeting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Are we already companions? I do not recall a previous meeting.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Yes, yes. Well, what do you want? I don't have a lot of time. Or I have too much time... depending on your perspective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, yes. Well, what do you want? I don't have a lot of time. Or I have too much time... depending on your perspective.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am getting some very strange readings from him. I detect no active Automata, and his heart beats once every ten seconds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am getting some very strange readings from him. I detect no active Automata, and his heart beats once every ten seconds.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: It takes a minute for my mind to focus. Like an old camera, if you know what such a thing is. But I see you now. Clearly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It takes a minute for my mind to focus. Like an old camera, if you know what such a thing is. But I see you now. Clearly.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Gideon? Who might he be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gideon? Who might he be?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: How is Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: A bounty hunter? What do you mean? I seek no bounty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A bounty hunter? What do you mean? I seek no bounty.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Well if it was, you'll never know. You don't know where he is. I've checked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well if it was, you'll never know. You don't know where he is. I've checked.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: I know you don't. That's why we have nothing else to discuss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know you don't. That's why we have nothing else to discuss.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: It's nice you assume that, because you don't know. And that's why we don't have anything further to discuss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nice you assume that, because you don't know. And that's why we don't have anything further to discuss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alan Fontus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alan Fontus?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We have talked before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have talked before.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe... I don't remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe... I don't remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you feeling OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you feeling OK?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can we talk?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can we talk?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you send Gideon after me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you send Gideon after me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you send Gideon after me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you send Gideon after me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want from me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want from me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want from me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want from me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't send any more bounty hunters after me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't send any more bounty hunters after me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't send any more bounty hunters after me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't send any more bounty hunters after me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't play dumb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't play dumb.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know what I'm talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what I'm talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You know what I'm talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You know what I'm talking about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it was all about Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it was all about Thaddeus?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it was all about Thaddeus?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it was all about Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you looking for Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you looking for Thaddeus?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you looking for Thaddeus?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you looking for Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: I know one thing about you. You can find me. Not a difficult task, but not an easy one either. But during this saeculum, you're not close enough to glimpse more than a fragment of the truth. I'll see you again, maybe next time round the wheel.
